description: ECB reference FX rates and currency conversion (via frankfurter.dev, open public data). Params: base, symbols (csv), optional amount, date, or start+end for a series. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: GET https://api.firstmention.uk/s/bizcal-api/fx

inputSchema.description: Give base and symbols; optional amount/date/start+end.

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD, with end, for a series

symbols.description: CSV of target currencies, e.g. USD,GBP

name: bizcal_api__fx
